a: a ≡ b (mod n) means n divides (a-b). Clock arithmetic.
gcd(a,b) is the greatest positive integer dividing both a and b.
lcm(a,b) is the smallest positive integer divisible by both a and b.
gcd(a,b) = gcd(b, a mod b) until remainder 0.
Every integer > 1 factors uniquely into primes (Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic).
Degree of a vertex is the number of edges incident to it.
A tree is a connected acyclic graph. n vertices ⇒ n-1 edges.
Boolean algebra uses AND, OR, NOT with values true/false (1/0).
A ∪ B is elements in A or B or both.
A ∩ B is elements in both A and B.
A − B is elements in A but not in B.
Surjective (onto): every element in the codomain is hit.
Bijective means both injective and surjective (invertible).
A recurrence defines terms using previous terms, e.g. a_n = a_(n-1) + a_(n-2).
